verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no auto-shutdown timer or spend-limit feature for Pods. The billing items are adjacent at best: prepaid credit billing and auto-pay reloading, which keeps instances running rather than capping spend. Serverless scale-to-zero applies to Serverless workers, not forgotten instances, and manual stop/terminate is a user action rather than a safeguard.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill
